name: iris_b
prompt: Extreme macro photograph looking straight at the iris of an enormous ancient eye, perfectly centered, the circular iris fills the frame edge to edge. Thousands of fine radial fibres like pale ash and bone, dry weathered stone texture, cold grey-white with faint dull amber near the center, deep crypts and folds between fibres, dark charcoal ring at the outer edge. No pupil: the center is plain dark grey. Dry and matte, not wet. No veins, no blood, no red, no eyelids, no eyelashes, no skin, no reflections, no text. Black background outside the iris.

name: arm_skin
prompt: Top-down flat orthographic material scan of pale ash-grey dry skin-like surface, like old parchment over thin bone, fine long wrinkles running mostly in one direction, subtle creases, faint tonal variation, cold grey with very slight warm undertone. Dry and matte. No veins, no blood, no wounds, no pores, no holes, no hair, no slime, no text. Even diffuse lighting, no perspective, fills the entire frame.
